Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option, provided you bring referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

For two people, the booking checkout will show the exact combined price.

The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive. You’ll need to wait at least *12 hours before flying* after the refresher and *18 hours* after the Referral Course. The Referral Course requires an overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The referral course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel. 🌊

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes 2 days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.
